prompt:
Use case: realistic photographic context assets for the Chinese character 茶, observing dry tea leaves, brewed leaves and tea liquid, in a children's Hanzi learning project.
Primary request: one 1024x1792 vertical triptych containing exactly three independent horizontal landscape photographs stacked in approximately equal-height panels, separated by two thin straight pure-white horizontal seams. No text.
Top photograph — exact context 浅碟里的干茶叶: a small pile of dry loose green tea leaves resting in a plain shallow light ceramic saucer on a natural wooden table. Show the whole saucer and distinct dry curled or narrow rolled leaves, with realistic brittle tea-leaf texture. No liquid in this scene; not herbs, coffee or powder.
Middle photograph — exact context 透明壶里泡开的茶叶: one complete transparent glass teapot resting safely on a plain table, containing pale golden-green brewed tea and visibly expanded wet tea leaves. The unfurled leaves are plainly visible through the glass, some resting near the bottom and some suspended in the liquid. No opaque infuser obscuring them. Show the whole teapot, lid, handle and spout with realistic glass reflections and refraction. Still life only: nobody pouring or touching hot water.
Bottom photograph — exact context 透明杯里的茶汤: one complete plain transparent glass cup containing clear golden-amber tea liquid, standing on a quiet wooden tabletop. Show the liquid's natural color and transparency, visible surface and glass rim and base; no milk, added fruit, decorative petals or colored-water gimmicks. No loose dry leaves beside this cup and no floating whole tea leaves in this bottom liquid-focused scene.
Style and light: photorealistic camera photographs, natural soft window daylight, real dry and wet leaf textures, realistic transparent glass, subtle reflections, wood grain and contact shadows. Separate independent tabletop scenes, no shared objects crossing seams.
Composition and safety: all saucers and vessels are centered, complete and surrounded by generous safe margins, including the teapot spout and handle. No people, children, hands, drinking, pouring, hot-water handling, kettles, flames, heating appliances or steam. No packaging, labels, text, captions, Chinese characters, logos, watermark, cartoon, illustration, diagram or decorative border.
reviewNotes: Inspected only a 300x525 JPEG preview. Top shows dry narrow green tea leaves in a complete shallow ceramic dish; middle shows visibly opened wet tea leaves at the bottom and suspended in golden-green liquid inside a complete clear teapot; bottom shows clear golden tea liquid in a complete transparent handled cup without floating leaves. Spout, handles, lid and vessel bases remain inside their panels. Realistic glass reflections and wooden surfaces are visible. No people, children, drinking, pouring, hot-water handling, steam, heating equipment or visible text. Original Sharp raw RGB white seam bands are 568–579 and 1207–1218, centers 574 and 1213; panel heights vary slightly.
